newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: HOT - Portugal Banco Sotto hits new high.
newsitem.headline: HOT - Portugal Banco Sotto hits new high.

text.p: Shares of Portugal's Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) hit a new high of 1,488 escudos on Wednesday and dealers said the stock's rise could continue.
"BPSM is cheap and has been relatively forgotten compared with the rest of the (banking) sector, and there are good prospects for 1997", said one dealer.
"I've seen international orders for the stock. Perhaps somebody has some good information on the bank's performance this year and is taking positions", said another dealer.
He added that BPSM shares had room to increase even more even if they dipped slightly just before the close to end at 1,480 escudos in trade of 623,195 shares.
The upcoming mid-year closing of portfolios may also be pushing BPSM up.
BPSM's share price has risen by some 40 percent since the beginning of the year, slightly below the PSI20 index of leading stocks which has gained 44 percent.
